Name: Dantes Wardrobe
Author: VegetaBul
Description:
衣柜中放着 Dante 3代和5代的服装，通过 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]FashionSense[/url]﻿ 替换（替换方式见FS mod介绍）。
安装说明：解压并将文件拖入 [i]Stardew Valley > Mods[/i]

[b]已经搬来的服装：[/b]

[list]
[*]3代、5代发型
[*]肌肉更明显的3代风衣
[*]3代风衣+护身符
[/list][list]
[*]5代风衣
[/list][list]
[*]5代夹克（但不露腰）
[/list][list]
[*]Dr. Faust：红魂帽 + 围巾 （抱歉，但打怪不爆红魂）
[/list][list]
[*]视频中的裤子、靴子，以及夹克搭配的袖子： [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]FashionSense[/url]﻿ 自带
[/list]
参考视频：[url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV19rCXB7EX8/?spm_id_from=333.1387.upload.video_card.click&vd_source=cd901cec0e60205d3a18279f1bb44855]Dante的衣柜（n网39386）_哔哩哔哩_bilibili

[/url][b]技术能力有限，[/b]通过 Accessories 装备的 5代风衣+红魂围巾的围巾 和 单独装备的围巾 动态效果不一致（没搞懂FS）

[b]Nero正在连夜整理打包的服装（未来计划）：[/b]

[list]
[*]1 2 4代风衣
[/list][list]
[*]5代靴子（工程量稍大且游戏中体现不明显，极大概率放弃）
[/list][list]
[*]5代夹克袖子（同样工程量稍大且游戏中体现不明显，极大概率放弃）
[/list]
特别鸣谢：Cotton_Spore 帮忙绘制3D发型😋


The wardrobe contains Dante’s DMC3 & 5 outfits, replaced through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]FashionSense[/url]﻿  (see the FS mod description for instructions).
[b]Mod installation:[/b] extract the zip file and drag it into [i]Stardew Valley > Mods[/i].

[b]Included outfits:[/b]
[list]
[*]DMC3, 5 hairstyle
[*]DMC3 coat
[*]DMC3 coat with amulet
[/list][list]
[*]DMC5 coat
[*]DMC5 jacket
[*]Dr. Faust: hat + scarf (Sry defeating monsters wont give u Red Orbs
[*]Pants, boots, and the jacket sleeves: included with [b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]FashionSense[/url]﻿[/b] by default
[/list]Example video: [url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV19rCXB7EX8/?spm_id_from=333.1387.upload.video_card.click&vd_source=cd901cec0e60205d3a18279f1bb44855]Dante的衣柜（n网39386）_哔哩哔哩_bilibili

[/url] Special thanks to Cotton_Spore for helping drawing 3D hairstyle.
